summary_1line: Sanjaya recounts Krishna’s vow to avenge the Pandavas while Bhima urges immediate war, but Yudhishthira insists on honoring their exile; a sage arrives.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima stands in the forest gripping his raised iron mace while angrily urging Yudhishthira to attack the Kauravas before the exile ends.
Krishna, enraged at the sight of the Pandavas in deer skins, vows before gathered warriors to destroy Duryodhana and restore their kingdom.
The weary Yudhishthira in forest garb greets the arriving sage Vrihadaswa with ritual offerings while lamenting his ruin through gambling.
